messages:
maria: Quick follow-up to the offline upgrader RFC — we didn't pin handshake timeouts and preemption behavior. Need defaults + safety nets for on-prem. Thoughts?

aj: Agree. Biggest failure mode is partial apply where node thinks it's done but missing blobs. Propose handshake state machine: OFFER -> ACCEPT -> STREAM -> VERIFY -> ACTIVATE. Timeouts: offer=30s, accept=60s, stream up to 10m, verify bounded per-GB. Add resumable streams with chunk offsets.

devon: +1. Add preemption token so operator can push higher-priority delta that cancels in-progress. Preemption semantics: if new seq > current and signature valid, agent aborts and starts new fetch. Ensure applies are idempotent (retries safe).

leila: Security: always verify signature before ACTIVATE; preemption only accepted if signature verifies and timestamp within a configured window. For air-gapped installs bind signature timestamp to a nonce to limit replay. Key rotation note: offline nodes may have stale root keys — allow back-compat where older keys are accepted if a rotation-list blob proves chain-of-trust.

maria: For resumable streams, prefer content-addressed chunking + manifest index. Agent keeps partial manifest state (downloaded chunk hashes + offsets) to resume missing pieces.

aj: Manifest example: 
```
seq: 42
chunks: ["sha256:abc...","sha256:def..."]
size_sum: 123456
```
Agent records downloaded chunk hashes -> resume from first missing chunk hash.

devon: Also need out-of-band operator kill: `upgraderctl cancel --seq=42` that sets a local abort flag; agent should retain rollback artifacts for 24h by default (configurable).

deploy-bot: Canary report: offline-upgrader canary on 3 nodes: 3/3 success, avg stream time 4m12s, resume exercised once (network hiccup), resumed and completed.

maria: Can we codify defaults for RFC follow-up: offer_timeout=30s, accept_timeout=60s, stream_timeout=15m, verify_timeout_per_GB=2m. Add metrics: bytes_streamed, resume_attempts, preemptions, signature_failures, active_quarantined_nodes.

aj: +1 on metrics. Also recommend circuit breaker: if 5 failed applies within 1h -> mark node quarantined and require manual intervention before next activation.

leila: Audit log requirements: entries MUST include signer_id, seq, manifest_hash, action (offer/accept/stream/verify/activate/preempt), and local preemption decision reason.

maria: I'll draft the follow-up RFC section with the state machine diagram, default timeouts, and metric/audit requirements. If no objections by EOD I'll fold into the RFC. :thumbsup: 

devon: No objections. Small request: add storage pressure handling section — agent may evict older blobs under pressure but must still be able to re-fetch missing chunks from seed peers or fallback registry.

maria: Good call, will add. Thanks all.
